content:
Maya: Quick proposal  new legend controls focusing on precision presets + density toggles instead of looser \u2018smoothing\u2019 term. Goal: make it obvious how values are computed and reduce axis clutter.
Riya: presets? like p50/p90 shorthand vs full precision decimals?
Maya: exactly. presets = { Compact (1 sig fig), Precise (3 sig figs), Exact (raw) } shown in legend as a tiny chevron menu.
Jonah: love preset idea. Suggest we show a micro-label when hovering the series name: e.g., "Precise: 12.345 ms". On mobile, long-press shows menu.
Priya: accessibility: ensure preset selection announces via SR: "Precision set to Precise for series X". Also keyboard shortcuts? maybe number keys to pick 1/2/3.
Maya: yes. Also add a per-series density toggle (instead of global smoothing) so SRE can view noisy infra metrics without hiding signal. legend menu item: "Density: low|med|high".
Riya: implementation thought: density maps to different smoothing kernels & bandwidth. docs should explain effect. Also include a graph bookmark that records the preset.
Jonah: UX nit: don't overload legend visually. Keep chips minimal: color swatch, short label, chevron. Menu options in a compact popover.
Priya: copy suggestions for menu items: "Precision: Compact (0.1), Precise (0.001), Raw" and "Density: Stable|Balanced|Responsive". Add short helper copy under options: "Stable: reduces transient spikes".
Maya: example payload we discussed for API persistence: 
```json
{
  "display": {
    "seriesOverrides": {
      "db_time": { "precision": "precise", "density": "balanced" },
      "ingest_rate": { "precision": "compact", "density": "responsive" }
    },
    "scope": "dashboard"
  }
}
```
Riya: good. For contrast/accessibility, color chips need a 3:1 contrast against white card bg. If not, show an outline or pattern.
Jonah: +1. Also legend should show an indicator when any series is using a non-default preset (small dot). Hover opens toast that says which series changed.
Priya: screen reader flow: Tab to legend, Enter opens menu, arrow keys to navigate, space to toggle control. After change, SR announces new state. We should add `aria-live=polite` region for changes.
Maya: mobile behavior: single tap opens compact sheet with options. Long-press opens advanced inspector. Icon-only legend on tight widths.
Riya: question: what about axis labels? We still keep unit abbreviations but reduce precision there. Axis shows rounded ticks, legend shows chosen precision.
Jonah: proposal: axis ticks always use "axisPrecision" setting (separate), default to compact. Legend precision controls the tooltip/legend value formatting.
Priya: accessibility copy for the legend control button: `aria-label=\"Open display menu for series db_time. Current precision: Precise, density: Balanced.\"`
Maya: DesignBot flagged spacing: small chip padding is now 4px which may affect touch targets. We need at least 44px tap size in mobile sheet.
DesignBot: Reminder: update component spec if chip padding < 6px to include larger hit area.
Riya: new microcopy for helper tooltips: "Precision presets control how values are rounded in the legend and tooltip. Use \u2018Precise\u2019 for analysis, \u2018Compact\u2019 for dashboard overviews."
Jonah: one more: export/CSV should honor selected precision & density, or include raw column if user picks \u2018Exact\u2019. Add toggle: "Include raw data".
Priya: action items: I'll draft accessible interaction spec + keyboard mapping. Riya will write helper copy and tooltip text. Jonah will prototype popover micro-interactions. Maya will update Figma and add mobile sheet.
Maya: thanks all. If nobody objects I'll move this into a design spike and tag eng next week. :sparkles:
